Ready to turn your creativity into something impactful? ✨

Laili Brand & Layali are opening an opportunity for aspiring creatives to join us as a Content Creator Intern. Bring your ideas to life, explore new possibilities, and grow your creative journey with us! 🤍

Requirements:
* Berkerudung dan menjalankan sholat 5 Waktu
* Mahasiswi aktif / semester akhir
* Mampu membuat brief, konten plan, dan editing video for sosmed
* Mampu menggunakan aplikasi edit vidio
* Punya skill komunikasi yang bagus dan bisa tampil di depan kamera
* iPhone user (diutamakan)

Benefit:
✨Biaya transportasi 250k per bulan
✨Surat rekomendasi magang/kerja
✨Kesempatan kerja di perusahaan kami
✨Produk pakaian senilai Rp499.000 - 999.000

📍WFO Surabaya Barat
Our insta @lailibrand @layali.ofc

📩 APPLY SEKARANG
Send your CV & portfolio to: Ms Diva 0896-9603-6080/WhatsAp
